newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said President of the Court of Auditors Bernhard Friedmann would present its annual report to the European Parliament in Strasbourg on Tuesday at 0900/0800 GMT followed by Commissioner Erkki Liikanen. Van der Pas said there would be a news conference at 1300/1200 GMT and that all documents would be available at 0900/0800 GMT in Brussels as in Strasbourg.

Van der Pas also announced news conferences by Commissioner Padraig Flynn on Court of Justice judgment on the work time directive at 1230/1130 GMT in the Council news room and by Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan on access strategy to markets at 1215/1115 GMT in the Breydel news room.
He said that DGVI Director General Guy Legras would comment on his hearing by the inquiry committee on BSE on Tuedsay at 1130/1030 GMT in the Breydel news room.

Spokeswoman Barbara Nolan said there would be a Health Council starting at 1000/0900 GMT on Tuesday. She said main points on the agenda would be the orientation debate communicable diseases, self sufficiency in blood, the advertising of tobacco products and draft Council conclusions on Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (TSE).

Spokesman Peter Guilford briefed on the Transatlantic Business Dialogue (TABD) conference that took place in Chicago over the week-end. He announced that an agreement had been reached between the Commission and the Spanish authorities to ensure opening of Spanish telecoms market by the end of 1998. Guilford said progress had also been made towards an information technology agreement (ITA) and a mutual recognition agreement.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1002: EU-Democratic Popular Republic Laos, extract of cooperation agreement.
- IP/96/1003: Eastern Zaire: Emma Bonino expresses deep disappointement following the interim resolution adopted last night by the UN Security Council.
- IP/96/1004: Homage session for Emile Noel, 28 November 1996.
- IP/96/1005: The Commission approves acquisition of TNT by PTT Post.
- IP/96/1006: Commission clears the acquisition of Duracell by Gilette.
- Speech/96/279: Speech by Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan on "Europe needs muscle to negotiate goods deals in new trade areas like investment".
- Speech/96/280: Speech by Commissioner Neil Kinnock on transport pricing policy.
- Speech/96/281: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler at the Rural development conference.
